comments.subject: Public Comments
comments.comment: Just want to make a general comment. My wife and I moved to St. George in July 2023 and absolutely love the city and people. We do have one concern though. In the months we have resided here we have not seen one traffic stop even though in our observations it is what we would call a target rich environment!!! Speeding, running of red lights, reckless driving and display of speed are frightening to say the least. What is wrong with being known as a "speed trap"? We would welcome that if it meant that incidents like the one that occurred at Bluff Street did not occur again. We never felt as insecure on the streets of our previous home as we do here. Possibly the one and only complaint we may have. Please consider enhanced enforcement of traffic laws in and around our neighborhoods. Thank You

notes: Single-page submission via the city public-comments web form. Personal info redacted.
